newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian election results show big Socialist win.
newsitem.headline: Albanian election results show big Socialist win.

text.p: Albania's electoral commission on Friday announced final results of June 29 presidential elections giving the Socialists 100 seats in the 155-seat assembly.
The Socialists' coalition allies took another 17 seats, and President Sali Berisha's Democratic Party won 27, including one for Berisha himself.
The results had been held up by a standoff between Berisha and his Socialist opponents, who wanted assurances that he would step down as president as soon as he had convened the new parliament.
Berisha on Thursday reiterated that he would resign rather than cohabit with a Socialist government.
Berisha's government, elected in disputed polls last year, resigned in March at the height of violent protests triggered by the collapse of get-rich-quick pyramid schemes.
International peacekeepers who deployed in April to assure security for aid deliveries and for the elections started returning home this week.
